title: Disproof of the Köthe conjecture (Krempa's matrix form)
abstract: Refutes Köthe's 1930 conjecture in Krempa's matrix form: there is a ring R (the unitization of a nil algebra of three weighted backward shifts over the algebraic closure of F_2) with a nil two-sided ideal I such that the matrix ideal M_2(I) contains a non-nilpotent matrix. The compared theorem is exactly the negation of the research-open statement `Koethe.KotherConjecture.variants.general_matrix` from Google DeepMind's Formal Conjectures, in every universe. The supporting library proves a multiprojective common-zero theorem via the Segre cone, the Nullstellensatz and Krull's height theorem, a mask-mortality theorem for one-row matrix pencils, a diagonal construction of universal mortal sequences, and a linearization theorem reducing nilness of a three-generator algebra to nilness of its root-row pencils.

informal.Koethe.KotherConjecture.variants.general: It is not the case that for every ring R, every nil two-sided ideal I of R and every finite index type n, the matrix ideal M_n(I) of M_n(R) is nil. This is the negation of Krempa's matrix form of Köthe's conjecture, stated verbatim as in Formal Conjectures.
informal.KoetheCounterexample.counterexample: In every universe there is a ring R with a nil two-sided ideal I such that some 2 x 2 matrix with entries in I is not nilpotent.
informal.KoetheMultiProjective.exists_common_zero: Over an algebraically closed field, at most 2N polynomials that are multihomogeneous of a common positive degree in each of N blocks of three variables have a common zero with no block equal to zero.
informal.KoetheCounterexample.maskMortality: Over an algebraically closed field, every one-row matrix pencil and every periodic mask with more than half of its residues free admit a mask-compatible word of nonzero letters whose forward product is the zero matrix.
informal.KoetheCounterexample.exists_universalMor: Over a countable field satisfying mask mortality there is a sequence of nonzero letter triples such that every pencil has all its windows of some fixed positive length equal to zero.
informal.KoetheCounterexample.nil_of_all_pencils_: If every root-row pencil lifted along three elements of an algebra is nilpotent, then the non-unital subalgebra they generate is nil.
